prompts.ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down pixel-art meadow ground atlas for the survival game Outpost, whose design canvas is 1920x1080 and terrain tiles are 64x64 native pixels. Create one square 1024x1024 PNG, an EXACT 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 square terrain tiles, 256x256 image pixels per cell, zero gutters, zero borders, no labels. Each cell represents a 64x64 native pixel tile enlarged exactly 4x by nearest-neighbor; draw deliberate square 4x4 pixel blocks and a restrained palette, NOT high-resolution painted noise. Strict orthographic ground viewed straight down, flat ground only; no sides, no isometric diamonds, no perspective, no horizon, no cast object shadows. Natural abandoned temperate meadow, moss and olive green with straw highlights, earthy umber dirt, cool deep green shadows, mature grounded survival-game atmosphere; calm terrain readable behind characters. Row 1: four subtle short meadow grass texture variants. Row 2: four grass variants with slightly different sparse straw and tiny clover patches, SAME grass edge colors as row1. Row3: four plain packed-earth texture variants, subdued warm brown, occasional very small stones. Row4: four dry loam earth variants with subtle gravel and root flecks, SAME dirt edge colors as row3. All 8 grass tiles must share compatible edge texture and tile seamlessly when placed adjacent, all 8 dirt tiles likewise. Opaque full-bleed textures filling every square completely, clean square tile boundaries. Even diffuse daylight, no central spotlight, no vignettes or strong clumps. No flowers, trees, large rocks, fences, water, characters, text, grid lines, checkerboard, logos or watermark.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production meadow environment prop SPRITE SHEET for Outpost, a grounded top-down pixel-art survival game at a 1920x1080 baseline with 64px ground tiles. Create a square 1024x1024 PNG with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, EXACTLY 16 isolated sprites in a precisely evenly spaced 4 by 4 grid of 256x256 cells. Each sprite entirely inside its cell, with generous empty transparent margins, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Every object centered horizontally, ground-contact point around y=205 within its cell. Consistent raised top-down orthographic RPG perspective (look down about 60 degrees, some front surfaces visible), NOT isometric diamond ground tiles, no perspective convergence. Detailed hand-placed pixel art: crisp square pixel clusters, earthy restrained palette, olive/moss meadow greens, straw tips, slate-grey rocks with muted lichens, umber wood, a few cream/dull yellow/lavender flowers; 1px dark contour at final native scale. This sheet is drawn at 4x native scale using block pixels, each prop intended for a native 64x64 cell. Diffuse daylight lit from upper left. The objects are natural and slightly weathered, not cute, not cartoon outlines. Row1 left to right: a low short grass tuft; tall grass clump; patch of small white daisies; patch of yellow meadow wildflowers. Row2: purple meadow wildflower patch; broad-leaf low clover patch; tiny tan mushroom group; leafy fern clump. Row3: small grey rock; medium angular mossy rock; three pebble cluster; larger lichen-speckled boulder. Row4: low green shrub; flowering low shrub; weathered chopped tree stump; short fallen weathered branch/log. Each patch is ONE isolated cohesive sprite, no loose disconnected faraway fragments. NO ground squares or grassy platforms underneath objects, no broad cast shadows, no checkerboard pattern, no solid backdrop, no labels, no typography, no borders, no grid lines, no scene, no watermark. Preserve real transparent gaps between leaves and around silhouettes.
prompts.trees: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: top-down pixel-art meadow TREES sprite atlas for Outpost, a grounded survival game with 1920x1080 design canvas, 64x64 terrain tiles. Generate a square 1024x1024 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Precisely 2 columns and 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells, FOUR COMPLETE distinct isolated trees, one per cell, no overlap, no clipping, plentiful empty margins. Top left: mature irregular broad-canopy meadow oak with visible weathered trunk. Top right: slender silver birch, light bark and airy leaf clusters. Bottom left: young narrower oak/sapling with thin brown trunk. Bottom right: weathered small dead meadow tree, broken crown, bare angled branches, a little moss and a few sparse leaves. All complete silhouettes from crown to roots, centered within each cell. Consistent high-angle 60-degree top-down orthographic RPG viewpoint, see upper leaf surfaces and a shortened lower trunk, NOT side elevation and NOT isometric diamond tiles. Upper-left diffuse daytime lighting. Same cohesive natural palette throughout: olive green, moss, muted sage highlights, deep cool forest shadows, bark umber, birch grey-cream. Native art is intended around 128x192 to192x256 per tree, 1-2px deliberate contours and crisp pixel clusters, restrained color ramps, no soft brushwork or photoreal foliage. Mature grounded post-apocalyptic meadow vegetation; no glowing fantasy colors, no cute cartoon forms. Shapes irregular and botanically readable. No ground islands or square bases, no large cast shadow, no scenery, no grass carpet beneath trees, no text, no labels, no framing, no grid, no checkerboard pattern, no watermark. Actual transparency inside gaps between branches and outside leaves.
prompts.paths: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: top-down meadow dirt footpath OVERLAY tile atlas for Outpost. Square 1024x1024 PNG with true transparent background. An EXACT 4x4 grid of sixteen 256x256 cells, no gutters and no lines. Each cell is a 64x64 native pixel terrain tile enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor: crisp square pixel clusters, no antialiasing, restrained earthy umber/tan dirt with subtle stones, ragged grassy olive fringe at the sides of the path. Strict overhead orthographic flat ground, no perspective, no shadows, no platforms. Transparent area everywhere outside the dirt trail and its small grass fringe. The path has a fixed width of 96 image pixels (24 native pixels) and connects to the EXACT CENTER of an indicated cell edge at x=128 or y=128. Path MUST touch the boundary of the cell on connected sides, seamlessly, and never touch unconnected sides. Each open connection has identical width and edge tone. Every shape stays in its own square. These are natural worn rural paths with softened irregular boundaries, not roads or bricks. Shape order is essential, left to right then top to bottom: Row1: isolated rounded dirt patch (no connections); north-facing dead-end (top connection); east-facing dead-end (right connection); northeast bend (top and right). Row2: south-facing dead-end (bottom); straight vertical path (top and bottom); southeast bend (right and bottom); T-junction connecting top, right and bottom. Row3: west-facing dead-end (left); northwest bend (top and left); straight horizontal path (left and right); T-junction connecting left, top and right. Row4: southwest bend (left and bottom); T-junction connecting left, top and bottom; T-junction connecting left, right and bottom; four-way crossing. Consistent path width, scale, muted olive grass fringe and earthy brown dirt color throughout. All corners rounded into usable footpath bends. No labels, arrows, text, grid lines, numbers, frames, grass-square backgrounds, checkerboard, characters, broad black outlines, water or watermark. True transparency for compositing over grass terrain.

prompts.chopped: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production chopped-tree state sprite atlas for Outpost, grounded top-down pixel survival game, matching mature meadow oak, silver birch, young oak and dead weathered tree. Square 1024x1024 PNG TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. Exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows of equal 256x512 cells, EIGHT separate isolated sprites with generous transparent padding. Upper row is FOUR ROOTED STUMPS. Lower row is FOUR MATCHING FELLED LOGS, one underneath its own stump. Column1 mature oak: a broad low stump with dark umber bark, moss at roots, light tan fresh cut oval with growth rings; beneath it a horizontal thick oak log, same bark and cut-end diameter, both sawn ends legible. Column2 birch: a smaller rooted white/grey birch stump with black bark markings and pale cut rings; beneath it a horizontal matching birch log with white/grey peeling bark. Column3 young oak: a small thin rooted brown sapling stump with small light cut top; beneath it a thin matching brown log. Column4 dead tree: a jagged weathered grey-brown stump with dry broken center; beneath it a dry broken deadwood log with a short branch stub. Every stump and log is a DISTINCT sprite, not combined with any tree canopy or foliage. Stumps should show their cut top planes prominently. High-angle 60-degree top-down orthographic RPG view, upper-left diffuse daylight, no long shadows. Pixel-art craft: restrained palette, deliberate crisp square clusters and 1-2px contours at native size, no photographic textures, no smoothing. Native target stump64x64, logs128x64 (source cells can have spare vertical space), logs horizontal left-to-right. Scale relationship between column pairs sensible; birch and sapling visibly thinner than oak. No standing trees, tree crowns, grass bases, ground tiles, labels, text, gridlines, border, solid background, checkerboard, watermark. Genuine alpha transparency around the complete roots and wood silhouettes.
prompts.transitions: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Outpost meadow grass-to-dirt TRANSITION terrain tilesheet. Exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows (12 isolated components), each component fits its own 384x341 cell with at least 24px padding; no overlaps.
